main_text.p: Sensus perhibebat) non dubitabant affirmare: Instabant qui rogaverant: Atqui, inquiebant, Sol, cum aliis oritur, tum aliis meridiem facit; simul igitur, & tanto major, & tanto minor Sol est: Hîc irretitos se senserunt Epicurei: cumque non esset, quod aptè responderi posse videretur, irridebantur. Sic Sensus suum gregem; Sed Genii nostri turpius longe, longe scelestius fallunt credulos & incautos suos sectatores, absque velut abrupto repente filo, in Philosophico Labyrintho destituunt, a confusionum Minotauro devorandos: Et hæc eorum non obscura prævaricatio, explorata satis cum helluone collusio; nisi Mores nos, quibus ceu fœdere quodam obstricti nefando monstro tenemur, fascinarent: Moribus effectum, ut errare non pudeat, ut irriti laboris non
[The continuation of this sentence follows on the next page.]

page.notes: Faint marginal text at the left edge of the scan is cut off and largely illegible; not transcribed. The text "Sensus perhibebat)" and following lines are transcribed as printed; "Instabant" read as printed. The bottom line ends with "non" as a catchword-like word; it is taken as the last word of the text line, and the note above is a placeholder. Some words at the margin (e.g. "Sensus" reference) are unreadable.
